source.check: returned unopposed: sole nomination in the Lisnaskea Rural list (Fermanagh Times, 28 April 1927, p. 6, 'The following nominations were handed in to Mr. Robert Clarke, Returning Officer') (page image read 7 Nov 2026); Ballindarragh was the only contest

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 2 June 1927 (queue nominal 26 May). Ballinadarragh was the only contest; the other divisions were filled by single nominations and are listed from the nomination report. No nominations were received for Aghakillymaude, Derrysteaton, Eshnafarragh or Rosslea, where the sitting members continued in office. Filed on 1927-05-25, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Fermanagh that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1927-06-02 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Coolnamarrow, Corrylongford and Derrylea are added from the Fermanagh Times, 28 April 1927, p. 6 (7 Nov 2026). Aghakillymaude, Derrysteaton, Rosslea and Eshnadarragh had no candidate; their retiring members were deemed re-elected but are not named in the sources read. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
